title: System Protocol 1: if
lessonSummary: Decision made! With if your program only acts when the condition is true.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: three simple if-conditions.
tasks.codeTemplate:
# Example 1: Simple if-condition
security_level = 5
if security_level >= 5:
    print("🎉 Access to main system granted!")

# Example 2: Checking True/False
system_online = True
if system_online:
    print("🔑 All systems operational.")

# Example 3: Checking a command
command = "START"
if command == "START":
    print("🚀 Launch sequence initiated!")

tasks.instruction: Create security_level = 7. Use if to check security_level >= 5 and print exactly: Access granted
Create command = "STOP". Use if to check command == "STOP" and print exactly: Engines halted

title: Important Operators: = vs ==
lessonSummary: Operators mastered! You know the difference between = and == and the four comparison algorithms.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: `=` vs `==` and all four comparison operators.
tasks.codeTemplate:
# Example 1: = vs == in comparison
rank = 15  # Assignment with =
if rank == 15:  # Comparison with ==
    print("✅ Correct: Rank 15 reached")

# Example 2: All four comparison operators
value = 42
print(f"Value: {value}")
print(f"{value} < 50: {value < 50}")
print(f"{value} <= 42: {value <= 42}")
print(f"{value} > 30: {value > 30}")
print(f"{value} >= 42: {value >= 42}")

tasks.instruction: Create speed = 900 and print exactly: speed > 1000: False (let the f-string calculate the comparison).
Create level = 10. Use if with == to check whether level is 10 and print exactly: Access level 10 reached!
Create energy = 15. Use if with < to check whether energy is below 20 and print exactly: Low energy!

title: System Protocol 2: if-else
lessonSummary: Two paths, one decision! else catches everything that if does not.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: three if-else decisions.
Create signals = 9. If signals >= 15, print Life forms detected!, otherwise print exactly: Sector empty.
Create energy = 45 and consumption = 50. If energy >= consumption, print f"Jump possible! Remaining: {energy - consumption}%", otherwise print exactly: Jump impossible! Missing: 5%

title: System Protocol 3: if-elif-else
lessonSummary: Many paths mastered! elif checks one condition after another – the first true path wins.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: a rank rating and a weapon system.
Create points = 120. Rate it: >= 1000 prints Fleet Commander!, >= 500 prints Captain!, >= 100 prints Lieutenant!, otherwise Cadet! – the program must print exactly: Lieutenant!
Create weapon = "Ion". If it is "Laser" print Laser activated!, if it is "Plasma" print Plasma cannon loaded!, otherwise print exactly: Unknown weapon!

title: System Protocol 4: Logical Operators (and, or, not)
lessonSummary: Logic connected! and, or and not let you combine several conditions into one decision.

tasks.instruction: Run this example: and, or, not and a ship class that combines them with elif.
tasks.codeTemplate:
# Example 1: and – both conditions must be true
has_access_code = True
has_fingerprint = True
if has_access_code and has_fingerprint:
    print("🔐👆 Access to the command deck granted!")

# Example 2: or – one condition is enough
has_emergency_key = False
has_override_code = True
if has_emergency_key or has_override_code:
    print("🔓 You can open the door manually!")

# Example 3: not – flips a truth value
alarm_active = False
if not alarm_active:
    print("✅ No danger – all systems secure!")

# Example 4: and inside an if-elif-else
shield = 8
weapons = 12
if shield > 10 and weapons > 10:
    print("⚔️🧠 Battleship!")
elif shield > 10:
    print("💪 Cruiser!")
elif weapons > 10:
    print("🧙 Destroyer!")
else:
    print("👤 Frigate!")

tasks.instruction: Create has_access_code = True and has_fingerprint = False. If BOTH are true (and) print Access granted!, otherwise print exactly: Access denied!
Create has_emergency_key = False and has_override_code = True. If at least ONE is true (or) print exactly: You can open the door manually!

validation.expected: You can open the door manually!
